title: Cross-CAM ML Closed-Loop — LoRA Cadence, Training Ledger, Feedback-to-Master-AI Wiring
brief: Close the 3 gaps identified in the CAM ML system: (1) extend the production-grade Lathe LoRA cadence pattern to the other 7 machine types (milling, 5-axis, grinding, wire EDM, sinker EDM, laser, waterjet, mill-turn); (2) build a cross-pipeline MasterAITrainingLedgerEngine generalized from LathePerformanceSLORegistryEngine + U-LPR-TRAINING-LEDGER; (3) close the loop from CAMAGIMasterOrchestrator orchestrator confidence back into fleet storage and per-CAM priors so the master AI continuously improves.
prerequisites: LATHE-PROD-READY-MS0 LoRA engines (49) as reference pattern

units.title: MillingLoRADatasetBuilderEngine + MillingLoRACadenceEngine
units.description: Generalize LatheLoRADatasetBuilderEngine + LatheLoRACadenceEngine into MillingLoRADatasetBuilder + MillingLoRACadenceEngine. Inputs: PrintToProgramPipeline outputs, actual CMM results, ERP actuals. Outputs: LoRA adapter for milling feed/speed + strategy selection. Cadence: nightly retrain with drift detection. Fingerprint: (material, tool_class, op_type, machine_class).
exit_conditions: MillingLoRACadenceEngine with nightly run + drift trigger
≥10 test cases verifying dataset shape + cadence triggers

units.title: FiveAxisLoRADatasetBuilderEngine + FiveAxisLoRACadenceEngine
units.description: 5-axis LoRA pipeline. Dataset: tilted-WP + TCPC + NURBS programs with actual surface finish results. LoRA adapter fine-tunes tool-axis optimization + singularity avoidance priors. Cadence: weekly (lower volume than milling). Integration with FiveAxisDeepLearningEngine.

units.title: MillTurnLoRADatasetBuilderEngine + MillTurnLoRACadenceEngine
units.description: Mill-turn LoRA pipeline. Dataset: multi-channel programs with sync marker performance (wait time, channel balance). LoRA adapter predicts optimal channel allocation + sub-spindle transfer timing. Cadence: weekly.
exit_conditions: Multi-channel sync performance captured in dataset

phases.title: LoRA Cadence Extension — EDM + Laser + Waterjet + Grinding

units.title: WEDMLoRADatasetBuilderEngine + WEDMLoRACadenceEngine
units.description: Wire EDM LoRA. Leverage existing WEDMFeedbackIngestionEngine + WEDMFeedbackCalibrationEngine. Dataset: 4-pass skim programs with actual Ra + wire-break events. LoRA predicts optimal pass schedule. Cadence: weekly.

units.title: SinkerEDMLoRADatasetBuilderEngine + SinkerEDMLoRACadenceEngine
units.description: Sinker EDM LoRA. Dataset: multi-electrode sequences with actual wear + surface finish. LoRA predicts electrode sequencing + orbit radius schedule. Cadence: monthly (low volume).

units.title: LaserLoRADatasetBuilderEngine + LaserLoRACadenceEngine
units.description: Laser LoRA. Dataset: nested sheet programs with actual pierce success + edge quality + dross events. LoRA predicts pierce strategy + lead-in/out geometry per material/thickness. Cadence: weekly.

units.title: WaterjetLoRADatasetBuilderEngine + WaterjetLoRACadenceEngine
units.description: Waterjet LoRA. Dataset: Q1-Q5 programs with actual edge taper + cycle time. LoRA predicts quality-to-feed mapping per material. Cadence: weekly.

units.title: GrindingLoRADatasetBuilderEngine + GrindingLoRACadenceEngine
units.description: Grinding LoRA. Dataset: traverse + plunge + creep-feed programs with actual Ra + wheel wear + burn-risk events. LoRA predicts infeed + spark-out schedule + dress interval. Cadence: weekly.

phases.title: Master AI Training Ledger — Cross-Pipeline Observability

units.title: MasterAITrainingLedgerEngine — generalized from LathePerformanceSLORegistry + U-LPR-TRAINING-LEDGER
units.description: One ledger that tracks all LoRA runs across 8 CAM pipelines. Schema: run_id, pipeline_type, dataset_fingerprint, training_metrics (loss, accuracy, MAE), deployment_status, SLO targets, actual vs predicted drift. Replay + audit per pipeline. Cross-pipeline comparison (which pipeline's LoRA is most stable).
exit_conditions: Ingests from all 8 pipeline LoRA cadence engines
Cross-pipeline SLO dashboard accessible via dispatcher

units.title: LoRADriftCoordinatorEngine — cross-pipeline drift detection
units.description: Monitors drift signals from all 8 pipeline LoRA DriftDetectors. Fires a master retrain trigger when 2+ pipelines drift simultaneously (suggests shared upstream cause like material batch variation). Publishes alerts to AGENT_CHAT.md + PagerDuty.

units.title: TrainingLedger dispatcher wiring — prism_ai.ledger_* actions
units.description: Add ledger_query, ledger_status, ledger_drift, ledger_replay, ledger_compare, ledger_slo to prism_ai dispatcher. Enables shop operator + agent access to cross-pipeline training health.
exit_conditions: 6 new prism_ai actions wired (enum + case handlers)
Dispatcher test suite ≥6 tests (one per action)

phases.title: Master AI Feedback Loop — Orchestrator Confidence → Fleet Priors

units.title: CAMAGIMasterOrchestratorEngine emits confidence_commit hook
units.description: After every orchestration decision, CAMAGIMaster emits (decision_id, reasoning_mode, chosen_cam, confidence, outcome_placeholder) via a new confidence_commit hook. OutcomeAccumulator updates on observed result.

units.title: OrchestratorConfidenceFeedbackEngine — writes back to fleet
units.description: When outcome is observed, OrchestratorConfidenceFeedback updates CAM-system-level Bayesian priors in the fleet (e.g., Mastercam performed 12% better than hyperMILL for this feature class on this material class). These priors feed CAMAGIMaster's next routing decision. Closes the loop.
exit_conditions: CAMAGIMaster reads priors on next routing

units.title: CrossCAMComparisonLedgerEngine — head-to-head CAM system performance
units.description: Per feature-class × material-class × machine-class cell, tracks which CAM system (hyperMILL / Mastercam / Fusion / InventorCAM / SolidCAM / NX / CATIA) produces best predicted-vs-actual agreement. Exposed via prism_ai.cross_cam_leaderboard.

units.title: End-to-end closed-loop test — JM Die job → actual → ledger → next-job priors
units.description: E2E test: run a JM Die part through CAMAGIMasterOrchestrator, record predicted cycle/Ra/force, simulate actual via CalibratedSimulationEngine perturbation, ingest via FeedbackCollectorEngine, verify SelfLearningCAMEngine Bayesian posterior shift, verify FleetLearningStrategy prior update, verify next orchestrator call picks a different (improved) strategy. 5-stage assertion chain.
exit_conditions: E2E test harness with 5-stage assertion chain
Real engines (no mocks) for all 5 stages

notes: Built on the LATHE-PROD-READY-MS0 LoRA reference pattern (49 engines). Extends closed-loop learning to cross-CAM master orchestration level. Prereq: existing 95 DL/LoRA engines + 92 learning/ingest/feedback engines remain in-place; this milestone wires them together at the master level rather than rebuilding.
